lines.speaker: TITLE
lines.visual: card:Miami, Florida|The Badge on Campus · Part two of two

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Last time, in Boca Raton, a prison company bought the name of a college stadium, and the students ran it out of town in six weeks. This time we are fifty miles south. And this time it is not a name on a building.
lines.caption: Last time, in Boca Raton, a prison company bought the name of a college stadium, and the students ran it out of town in six weeks. This time we are fifty miles south. And this time it is not a name on a building.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Miami, Florida. Florida International University. The I stands for international. More than thirty-five hundred students are here on visas. About two out of three students are Hispanic.
lines.caption: Miami, Florida. Florida International University. The I stands for international. More than thirty-five hundred students are here on visas. About two out of three students are Hispanic.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: In early 2025 the governor pressed Florida's public universities to sign up their campus police with ICE. The agreement lets a campus officer question a person about immigration status, check the federal databases, and make the arrest.
lines.caption: In early 2025 the governor pressed Florida's public universities to sign up their campus police with ICE. The agreement lets a campus officer question a person about immigration status, check the federal databases, and make the arrest.
lines.visual: card:287(g)|The federal program that deputizes local officers for immigration work

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: Campus police. The people who unlock your car and write parking tickets.
lines.caption: Campus police. The people who unlock your car and write parking tickets.

lines.speaker: S
lines.say: Same department, Gary. The federal program is called 287(g). It deputizes local officers to do immigration work.
lines.caption: Same department, Gary. The federal program is called 287(g). It deputizes local officers to do immigration work.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: FIU's police applied in April 2025. That same month the school confirmed that eighteen of its students had their visas revoked.
lines.caption: FIU's police applied in April 2025. That same month the school confirmed that eighteen of its students had their visas revoked.
lines.visual: card:18 visas revoked|Confirmed by FIU · April 2025

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: The students came out. The chant was, paws off our students. The chair of the board said no student should be fearful if they are here legally and in compliance with the law.
lines.caption: The students came out. The chant was, paws off our students. The chair of the board said no student should be fearful if they are here legally and in compliance with the law.
lines.visual: card:“Paws off our students”|The chant at FIU · April 2025

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: Well, he has a point. If you are legal you have got nothing to worry about.
lines.caption: Well, he has a point. If you are legal you have got nothing to worry about.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Eighteen students had a valid visa one day and did not have one the next. Legal is a word that somebody else gets to change.
lines.caption: Eighteen students had a valid visa one day and did not have one the next. Legal is a word that somebody else gets to change.
lines.visual: card:Legal is a word that somebody else gets to change.|

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: On July 2, 2025, the agreement became final. At least fifteen public colleges and universities in Florida signed one. Reporters could not find a single one in any other state.
lines.caption: On July 2, 2025, the agreement became final. At least fifteen public colleges and universities in Florida signed one. Reporters could not find a single one in any other state.
lines.visual: card:July 2, 2025|At least fifteen Florida public colleges and universities signed

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: The president said the only thing that really changed was that FIU was in control. A professor said it shorter. FIU without the I is F U.
lines.caption: The president said the only thing that really changed was that FIU was in control. A professor said it shorter. FIU without the I is F U.
lines.visual: card:“FIU without the I is F U.”|Philip Stoddard, FIU professor

lines.speaker: S
lines.say: That was Philip Stoddard, a professor here at FIU.
lines.caption: That was Philip Stoddard, a professor here at FIU.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: So the students did what the students up the road did in 2013. They organized. They called themselves ICEBreakers. In March 2026, at an event with the president, they stood up in T-shirts that said ICE off FIU. They did not say a word. It lasted under five minutes.
lines.caption: So the students did what the students up the road did in 2013. They organized. They called themselves ICEBreakers. In March 2026, at an event with the president, they stood up in T-shirts that said ICE off FIU. They did not say a word. It lasted under five minutes.
lines.visual: card:ICE off FIU|The T-shirts · March 2026 · under five minutes, not a word

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Seven of them were charged under the school's expressive activities policy. Each one got a written reprimand. And each one was ordered to record a two minute reflection video, or lose the right to register for class or collect a diploma.
lines.caption: Seven of them were charged under the school's expressive activities policy. Each one got a written reprimand. And each one was ordered to record a two minute reflection video, or lose the right to register for class or collect a diploma.
lines.visual: card:A two minute reflection video|Or no registration and no diploma

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: A reflection video. For standing up in a T-shirt.
lines.caption: A reflection video. For standing up in a T-shirt.

lines.speaker: S
lines.say: Two minutes, due September 4.
lines.caption: Two minutes, due September 4.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: In August they sued in federal court, with the ACLU of Florida. That case is still open.
lines.caption: In August they sued in federal court, with the ACLU of Florida. That case is still open.
lines.visual: card:August 2026|Federal court · with the ACLU of Florida

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: To be fair to the school. FIU says there has not been one immigration enforcement action on its campuses since it signed. And the president says ICE would have access either way.
lines.caption: To be fair to the school. FIU says there has not been one immigration enforcement action on its campuses since it signed. And the president says ICE would have access either way.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: But put the two stories side by side. In 2013 the students said no, and the company went home and the president resigned. In 2026 the students said no, and they got homework.
lines.caption: But put the two stories side by side. In 2013 the students said no, and the company went home and the president resigned. In 2026 the students said no, and they got homework.
lines.visual: card:2013: the company went home.|2026: the students got homework.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Ask yourself again. Who is out of line? The kid in the T-shirt? Or the people who made the police chief a deputy and the protest a violation?
lines.caption: Ask yourself again. Who is out of line? The kid in the T-shirt? Or the people who made the police chief a deputy and the protest a violation?

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: I take it back. Both times.
lines.caption: I take it back. Both times.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: We will follow the lawsuit. Miami, Florida. Keep it real.
lines.caption: We will follow the lawsuit. Miami, Florida. Keep it real.
